description: This file defines the Express.js route handling for products, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve list of products

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific product by id

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new product

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing product by id

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a product by id
